name: OffOn — Statsig Observability
description: Two Statsig concepts tracked separately: AB Test experiments (careers_experiment) and Feature Gate (react_migration_test)

pages.name: AB Test — Results
pages.description: Statsig AB test: careers_experiment control vs challenger conversions (data from browser PageAction events)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(session) AS 'Sessions' FROM PageView SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Assigned' FROM PageAction WHERE actionName = 'experiment_assigned' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Clicks' FROM PageAction WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked') AS 'Conversion %' FROM PageAction WHERE actionName IN ('experiment_assigned','apply_clicked') SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PageAction WHERE actionName = 'experiment_assigned' FACET variation SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PageAction WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked' FACET variation_label SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT filter(uniqueCount(session), WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked') / uniqueCount(session) * 100 AS 'Conversion %' FROM PageAction WHERE actionName IN ('experiment_assigned','apply_clicked') FACET variation SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PageAction WHERE actionName = 'experiment_assigned' FACET variation TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PageAction WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked' FACET variation_label TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT funnel(session, WHERE actionName = 'page_view' AS 'Page Viewed', WHERE actionName = 'experiment_assigned' AS 'Experiment Assigned', WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked' AS 'Apply Clicked') FROM PageAction SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT funnel(session, WHERE actionName = 'experiment_assigned' AND variation = 'control' AS 'Assigned (Control)', WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked' AND variation_label = 'Control' AS 'Converted (Control)') FROM PageAction SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT funnel(session, WHERE actionName = 'experiment_assigned' AND variation = 'challenger' AS 'Assigned (Challenger)', WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked' AND variation_label = 'Challenger' AS 'Converted (Challenger)') FROM PageAction SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PageAction WHERE actionName = 'apply_clicked' FACET job_title, variation_label SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Count' FROM PageAction WHERE actionName IN ('experiment_assigned','apply_clicked') FACET variation, actionName SINCE 7 days ago

pages.name: AB Test — Edge Assignments
pages.description: Statsig AB test assignments logged by Vercel Edge Middleware before HTML is served (data from New Relic Log API)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Assignments' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'New Users' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' AND is_new_user = true SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Returning' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' AND is_new_user = false SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT uniqueCount(user_id) AS 'Unique Users' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET variation SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET variation, is_new_user SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET path, variation SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET variation TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT timestamp, experiment, variation, user_id, is_new_user, path FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: Feature Flag — react_migration_test
pages.description: Statsig gate: react_migration_test — state-change events pushed from .NET StatsigGateCache whenever the flag is toggled in Statsig dashboard

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'State Changes' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'feature_flag_state_change' AND flag_name = 'react_migration_test' AND trigger = 'state_change' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT latest(enabled) AS 'Flag Enabled?' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'feature_flag_state_change' AND flag_name = 'react_migration_test' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'ON Events' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'feature_flag_state_change' AND flag_name = 'react_migration_test' AND enabled = true AND trigger = 'state_change' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'OFF Events' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'feature_flag_state_change' AND flag_name = 'react_migration_test' AND enabled = false AND trigger = 'state_change' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT timestamp, flag_name, enabled, trigger FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'feature_flag_state_change' AND flag_name = 'react_migration_test' SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 100 ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'feature_flag_state_change' AND flag_name = 'react_migration_test' FACET enabled TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

pages.name: AB Test — Health
pages.description: AB test experiment staleness (5-day threshold) and kill switch tracking

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(experiment) AS 'Active' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' SINCE 5 days ago
SELECT uniqueCount(experiment) AS 'Stale' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' SINCE 30 days ago UNTIL 5 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Assignments' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' SINCE 5 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Kill Events' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'kill_switch_activated' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'Last Seen', count(*) AS 'Total (30d)' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET experiment SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Active vs Stale Assignments per Experiment

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Last 5 days (Active)' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET experiment SINCE 5 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Older 5-30 days (Stale)' FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET experiment SINCE 30 days ago UNTIL 5 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'edge_flag_assignment' FACET experiment TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT timestamp, feature_flag, path FROM Log WHERE logtype = 'kill_switch_activated' SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: Performance
pages.description: Core Web Vitals and page load timing

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(largestContentfulPaint) AS 'LCP (s)' FROM PageViewTiming SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(cumulativeLayoutShift) AS 'CLS' FROM PageViewTiming SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(interactionToNextPaint) AS 'INP (ms)' FROM PageViewTiming SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode >= 400) AS 'Error %' FROM AjaxRequest SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT average(domProcessingDuration) AS 'DOM Processing', average(pageRenderingDuration) AS 'Page Rendering', average(networkDuration) AS 'Network', average(frontendDuration) AS 'Total Frontend' FROM PageView TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(largestContentfulPaint) FROM PageViewTiming FACET pageUrl TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT average(largestContentfulPaint) AS 'LCP (s)', average(cumulativeLayoutShift) AS 'CLS', average(interactionToNextPaint) AS 'INP (ms)', average(firstContentfulPaint) AS 'FCP (s)' FROM PageViewTiming FACET pageUrl SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Errors', latest(httpResponseCode) AS 'Status' FROM AjaxRequest WHERE httpResponseCode >= 400 FACET requestUrl SINCE 24 hours ago
